implementation: Handwritten readable C; original instructions execute only in independent tests

implemented_routines.name: fx_main_loop_begin/tick/accept_token/accept_handler
implemented_routines.scope: Semantic caller lifecycle, real key wait, menu and screen routing, prepared actual-return policy and framebuffer flush

implemented_routines.name: screen selection and admission
implemented_routines.scope: FC/FD blockers, mode admission, bounded exported-expression transfer and persistent screen/flag reset

api: Begin only at a real boot READY boundary; tick retains semantic requests until the actual callee returns. Complete INPUT with the D9EE context-return byte, not its subordinate evaluator action.
prepared_domain: Actual outer key-controller lifecycle and ordinary header classification are used; no80FB workaround or fabricated ready flag.
Pending UI/menu/screen requests do not model untranslated callee instructions.
High-bit screen exit admits terminated exported expressions shorter than100 bytes.

Final observable parity includes all RAM/MMIO except native CPU stack8D00..8DED, plus callback and appropriate named wait/menu caller state. Intermediate CPU registers and instruction ordering are not host API semantics.
gaps: D9EE UI, mode/setup/parameter menus and specialized-screen request bodies require their real high-level controllers.
True ordinary reset to first key wait is verified with the actual linked bootE6 UI completion; the evaluation phase explicitly inventories incomplete numeric workspaces.
Physical interrupt/timer scheduling remains a host capability; the default diagnostic lifecycle now executes the high-level ROM/status/retention routine against a software resource backend.
